surfaces.label: Contact command, query, template, and code injection
surfaces.notes: Full route review found no shell, database, dynamic template, eval, or code-execution sink.

surfaces.label: Contact email field handling
surfaces.notes: Structured Resend JSON fields prevent raw SMTP-header concatenation; control-character rejection remains defense in depth.

surfaces.label: Contact body parsing and abuse controls
surfaces.notes: The instance-local rate-limit finding survived; body and in-memory cardinality candidates were rejected under platform bounds.

surfaces.label: Fixed upstream requests
surfaces.notes: Turnstile and Resend destinations are fixed. Explicit timeouts remain a hardening action, but no attacker-selected destination or attacker-created stall survived.

surfaces.label: Runtime filesystem access
surfaces.notes: No filesystem mutation, upload, archive, or attacker-selected path API exists.

surfaces.label: Authentication and object isolation
surfaces.notes: The application has no account, protected object, privileged role, or private state surface.

surfaces.label: Static content and structured rendering
surfaces.notes: Values are developer-controlled and are escaped or serialized for their contexts; no lower-privileged authoring boundary exists.

surfaces.label: Contact browser boundary
surfaces.notes: The cross-origin submission finding survived; CSP and script allowlisting are tracked as hardening.
surfaces.riskArea: Cross-origin actions and third-party script policy

surfaces.label: Environment and provider configuration
surfaces.notes: Partial Turnstile configuration survived as a finding; secrets remain server-only.

surfaces.label: Dependencies and build configuration
surfaces.notes: Production and full npm audits reported zero known vulnerabilities.

surfaces.label: Browser and CDN response policy
surfaces.notes: No standalone vulnerability survived; explicit security headers, no-store API responses, and immutable versioned assets are tracked as hardening.

surfaces.label: Public bundle and repository data
surfaces.notes: Tracked-file secret scanning found no credential pattern or private local path.
